title: project.extract request
description: Extract every registered carrier into the project, as one reviewed write. `prepared_output`: `prepare` reports the plan and writes nothing, `commit_reviewed` re-derives it and writes only if the digest still matches. Each recovered member becomes an object carrying the selector that reproduces it, so a materialised file is a convenience rather than the only copy. The project is named by the envelope's `project` locator.

sources.description: Which registered sources to extract. Omitted or empty means every one of them, which is what makes a five-disk project one decision rather than five.

maximum_input_bytes.description: Per-source ceiling. The aggregate ceilings — objects, total recovered bytes — are the context's.
